items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: But Heidi wasn’t really that hot in it. I don’t know what it was with her.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was just going to say, like would you recommend a career in jazz to a young person these days?

Why not? I mean if they have the gumption to get into it and stick with it and work it out, and the talent of course, sure why not. But Heidi wasn’t really that hot in it. I don’t know what it was with her.
You have to be kind of driven I think.
